decision.summary: A confirmed temporary offset in E (610–660) with correlated N decline and U rise; a subsequent uncertain partial recovery in E (661–675) without matching N/U reversal, suggesting either incomplete return or superposed motion.

intervals.observation: E shows sustained descent (~-4.5 to -8.2 MAD) from index 610 to 660; N declines modestly (~-2.0 to -7.9 MAD), U rises (~-0.1 to +2.0 MAD). Interior is coherent across axes, with no reversal before 660.

E reverses sharply upward (from ~-8.2 to -6.9 MAD) at ~660–662, while N continues downward and U remains elevated; return of E is incomplete and not mirrored in N/U—ambiguous whether full offset recovery occurs within allowed context.
